acceptance_rule: Accept if: (1) data/exit_lifecycle/YYYYMMDD.jsonl files are generated each production run, (2) records contain ticker, as_of_date, advisory_events, has_advisory_event, (3) alters_orders=False on all records, (4) no change to any core strategy metric.
hypothesis: Production computes profit ladders, time stops, trailing stops, and target-price advisory exits but does not log when they trigger. Adding a daily JSONL shadow log of advisory exit events enables future closed-position attribution comparing advisory trigger vs actual outcome.

prediction.confidence_reason: Pure shadow log; no strategy change. Generates data/exit_lifecycle/ files.
